paragraphs: ModivCare sells non-emergency medical transportation, personal care services, and monitoring solutions. Listed services include transportation, chronic care management, and personal in-home assistance with activities of daily living. MyModivcare is described as a hub for members and caregivers to book and manage rides and find forms.

Clients listed include public and private payers, health systems, hospitals and universities. Patient populations served range from children to older adults, in urban areas and in rural communities. Value-based solutions are said to help customers manage risks, reduce costs, and improve health outcomes.
Security certifications listed include HITRUST, AICPA SOC 2 Type II, and HIPAA. Reports and attestations are offered to companies that sign a non-disclosure agreement.

quote.text: ModivCare is transforming healthcare by connecting people with the care they need, wherever they are.
